Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers. Resignation of Director On October 29, 2026, Linda Knoll notified the Board of Directors (the "Board") of Astec Industries, Inc. (the "Company") of her intention to resign from the Board and all committees thereof, effective as of December 14, 2026. Ms. Knoll’s decision to resign was not the result of any disagreement between Ms. Knoll and the Company. Appointment of Director On October 30, 2026, the Board of the Company appointed Mr. John Keating as a member of the Board, effective December 11, 2026. Mr. Keating will serve for an initial term expiring at the 2027 annual meeting of stockholders. The Board also appointed Mr. Keating to the Board's Audit Committee, also effective December 11, 2026. Mr. Keating, age 65, has served as a senior advisor to CRH plc ("CRH"), a leading provider of building materials solutions, since January 1, 2026. From 2022 to 2026, Mr. Keating served as Executive Vice President, Americas Materials Solutions and Leader, Global Domains Performance Initiative, North America & Europe of CRH. Prior to that, from 1994 to 2022, Mr. Keating held various positions of increasing responsibility in CRH's Americas Materials Solutions division and its predecessor businesses. The Board has determined that Mr. Keating qualifies as "independent" under the requirements of the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC and the Company's Corporate Governance Guidelines. There are no arrangements or understandings with any person pursuant to which Mr. Keating was elected as a director of the Company. In addition, there are no transactions directly or indirectly involving Mr. Keating that would be required to be disclosed pursuant to Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K. Mr. Keating will receive the annual compensation that the Company provides to other non-employee members of the Board. A copy of the press release announcing the resignation of Ms. Knoll as a director and the appointment of Mr. Keating to the Board is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1. Item 9.01.
